scenarios.prompt: A poise pool reaches exactly zero from two same-tick contacts during an armored move. Define one stagger event, refill/reset policy and armor interaction.

criteria.ownership: Persistent poise pool is owned here; move-local armor belongs to hyper-armor and stagger duration to hitstun-recover.
criteria.threshold: Maximum, damage, threshold, refill/reset and armor interaction are explicit data.
criteria.identity: Multiple contacts cannot create duplicate break events or rewards unless authored.
